description: This file contains Sass mixins for form validation styling, defining reusable style blocks for validation states such as valid and invalid, including feedback messages, tooltips, and form controls.

methods.name: form-validation-state-selector
methods.description: A mixin that creates CSS selectors for validation states, making styles conditionally apply based on the provided state (valid or invalid).

methods.name: form-validation-state
methods.description: A mixin that styles form validation feedback, tooltips, and form controls based on validation state, including colors, icons, and focus styles.
